workflow_steps.name: Change Proposal & Impact Analysis
workflow_steps.description: Analyze proposed changes and assess impact on existing architecture

actions.purpose: Ensure changes align with system mission, user scenarios, success criteria

gates.name: Foundational Alignment Gate
gates.note: MANDATORY gate - cannot proceed without foundational alignment

workflow_steps.name: Functional Architecture Analysis (Invoke Comprehensive Workflow)
workflow_steps.description: Invoke comprehensive 01d-functional_analysis.json workflow for rigorous functional analysis of feature changes
workflow_steps.rationale: Feature updates require the same rigorous functional analysis as new systems to catch gaps, redundancies, and ensure proper integration. Invoking dedicated workflow ensures consistency, automated gap closure, and comprehensive validation.

workflow_invocation.purpose: Run full 7-step functional analysis workflow (FA-01 through FA-07) on feature changes
workflow_steps_invoked: FA-01: Functional Requirements Extraction (extract requirements for new feature)
FA-02: Functional Flow Definition (define flows for new feature, decompose into atomic functions)
FA-03: Functional Architecture Visualization (generate BPMN/UML diagrams showing feature changes)
FA-04: Stakeholder Validation (MANDATORY - obtain sign-off on feature visualizations)
FA-05: Technical Analysis & Gap Detection (automated gap detection, redundancy analysis, efficiency analysis)
FA-06: Iterative Refinement (dual validation loop - stakeholder + technical, includes FA-06-A02B automated gap closure)
FA-07: Functional Architecture Finalization (complete functional architecture package)
benefits: Automated gap closure using reflow_gap_closure.py (FA-06-A02B) - catches functional gaps in feature changes
Dual validation: stakeholder (via visualizations) + technical (via graph analysis)
No code duplication - single source of truth for functional analysis
Same rigor for feature updates as new systems

integration_notes.delta_visualization: 01d workflow will read existing specs/functional/functional_architecture.json and highlight deltas (current vs. proposed) in visualizations
integration_notes.stakeholder_focus: FA-04 stakeholder review focuses on change impacts and new feature functions
integration_notes.gap_closure: FA-06-A02B automated gap closure proposes solutions for any functional gaps introduced by feature
integration_notes.output_compatibility: 01d workflow outputs same artifacts (functional_architecture.json, visualizations, stakeholder sign-off) expected by FU-02 functional allocation step

actions.description: Invoke 01d-functional_analysis.json workflow for comprehensive functional analysis
actions.purpose: Execute full 7-step functional analysis workflow (FA-01 through FA-07) to analyze feature changes

workflow_steps_executed.FA-01: Extract functional requirements for new feature from change proposal and foundational documents
workflow_steps_executed.FA-02: Define functional flows for new feature, decompose into atomic functions, identify dependencies
workflow_steps_executed.FA-03: Generate MANDATORY human-readable visualizations (BPMN process flows, UML data flows, decision trees) showing feature deltas (current vs. proposed)
workflow_steps_executed.FA-04: MANDATORY stakeholder validation - review visualizations, obtain sign-off on proposed feature changes
workflow_steps_executed.FA-05: Technical analysis - automated gap detection, redundancy detection, efficiency analysis using system_of_systems_graph_v2.py
workflow_steps_executed.FA-06: Iterative refinement - dual validation loop combining stakeholder feedback AND technical analysis. Includes FA-06-A02B automated gap closure using reflow_gap_closure.py
workflow_steps_executed.FA-07: Finalization - create complete functional architecture package with all deliverables

- G-FA-06: Functional Architecture Validated (BLOCKING - dual validation passed)

Respect existing service boundaries where appropriate
Identify new services if needed for new functions

semantic_versioning_decision.determine_version_increment: Based on impact analysis from FU-01-A03
semantic_versioning_decision.major: If breaking changes identified → increment major version (v1.x.x → v2.0.0)
semantic_versioning_decision.minor: If new capabilities added (non-breaking) → increment minor (v1.0.x → v1.1.0)
semantic_versioning_decision.patch: If bug fixes or clarifications only → increment patch (v1.0.0 → v1.0.1)

critical_reminders: ALWAYS run validate_foundational_alignment.py before proceeding (gate G-FU-01 is MANDATORY)
FU-01A invokes comprehensive 01d-functional_analysis.json workflow - DO NOT skip this, it's the same rigorous analysis used for new systems
01d workflow includes 7 steps (FA-01 through FA-07) with automated gap closure, stakeholder validation, and technical analysis
Workflow invocation syntax: 'Implement workflow in {reflow_root}/workflows/01d-functional_analysis.json on system {system_root}' with entry_point 'from_feature_update'

01d workflow automatically handles: functional requirements extraction, flow definition, BPMN/UML visualizations with deltas, stakeholder review, gap detection, automated gap closure proposals, iterative refinement
All 7 quality gates from 01d workflow (G-FA-01 through G-FA-07) must pass before proceeding to FU-02
STAKEHOLDER VALIDATION is MANDATORY (enforced by 01d workflow gate G-FA-04) - stakeholders must approve visualizations showing feature changes
DUAL VALIDATION is MANDATORY (enforced by 01d workflow gate G-FA-06) - BOTH stakeholder validation AND technical analysis must pass
Automated gap closure (FA-06-A02B in 01d workflow) will propose solutions for functional gaps introduced by feature - review proposals before accepting
Version all updated service_architecture.json files in FU-02 (don't overwrite)
Ensure functional allocation matrix in FU-02-A00 maps ALL functions to services
Highlight breaking changes clearly in delta report (FU-03)
Run regression testing (FU-05) to catch unintended side effects
common_mistakes: Trying to implement FU-01A actions inline instead of invoking 01d-functional_analysis.json workflow
Proceeding to FU-02 without waiting for 01d workflow to complete all 7 steps
Ignoring automated gap closure proposals from FA-06-A02B (review them!)
Skipping stakeholder validation (enforced by 01d workflow but LLM must facilitate)
Not creating BPMN/UML diagrams showing current vs. proposed changes (01d workflow does this, but verify outputs exist)
Proceeding to FU-02 with unresolved functional architecture issues from 01d workflow
Forgetting to create functional allocation matrix in FU-02-A00
Overwriting old architecture versions instead of creating new versions (FU-02-A01)
Not identifying breaking changes in delta report (FU-03)

workflow_philosophy.two_phase_approach: Functional Architecture with Workflow Invocation (WHAT) → Functional Allocation (HOW)
workflow_philosophy.phase_1_functional_architecture_via_work: FU-01A invokes 01d-functional_analysis.json workflow which handles: requirements extraction (FA-01), flow definition & decomposition (FA-02), MANDATORY visualizations with deltas (FA-03), MANDATORY stakeholder validation (FA-04), automated technical analysis (FA-05), iterative refinement with dual validation and automated gap closure (FA-06), finalization (FA-07). This ensures feature updates receive the SAME rigorous analysis as new systems.
workflow_philosophy.phase_2_functional_allocation: FU-02 allocates functions (from 01d workflow output) to systems/services. Updates system architectures with versioning. Uses UAF or other frameworks for system definition.
workflow_philosophy.workflow_invocation_benefits: Consistency (same rigor for new systems AND feature updates), Automated gap closure (catches functional gaps in features), No code duplication (single source of truth), Comprehensive validation (7 quality gates vs 1 gate), Stakeholder alignment (mandatory visualization and sign-off), Technical correctness (automated gap/redundancy/efficiency analysis)
workflow_philosophy.lesson_learned: Previous condensed FU-01A approach lacked automated gap closure, comprehensive validation, and consistency with new system workflows. Invoking dedicated 01d workflow ensures feature updates are analyzed with the same rigor as greenfield systems, preventing architectural debt accumulation.

mandatory_gates: G-FU-01 (Foundational Alignment Gate) - cannot proceed without foundational alignment

G-FU-01A (Functional Architecture Workflow Complete) - delegates to 01d-functional_analysis.json, which enforces 7 gates: G-FA-01 (requirements), G-FA-02 (architecture defined), G-FA-03 (visualizations), G-FA-04 (stakeholder validation - BLOCKING), G-FA-05 (technical analysis), G-FA-06 (dual validation - BLOCKING), G-FA-07 (finalization). Cannot proceed to FU-02 until 01d workflow completes successfully.

workflow_invocation_details.how_to_invoke: When LLM reaches FU-01A step, invoke: 'Implement workflow in {reflow_root}/workflows/01d-functional_analysis.json on system {system_root}' with context that this is a feature update (entry point: from_feature_update)
workflow_invocation_details.what_01d_does: Executes FA-01 through FA-07, automatically handling all functional analysis tasks including visualization generation, stakeholder validation facilitation, automated gap detection, and iterative refinement
workflow_invocation_details.when_01d_completes: 01d workflow completes at FA-07 after all gates pass. LLM then proceeds to FU-02 functional allocation using 01d outputs.
workflow_invocation_details.outputs_to_use_in_fu_02: functional_architecture.json (updated), functional_allocation_matrix.json (if created in FA-07), stakeholder sign-off documentation, gap closure proposals (if applicable)
